build_vit_3d_model: build a 3D Vision Transformer model for video classification with configurable patch sizes and transformer depth
create_attention_layer: create a multi-head self-attention layer with QKV projection, softmax attention, and dropout
create_feedforward_network: create a feedforward network with layer norm, linear layers, GELU activation, and dropout
create_transformer_encoder: create a transformer encoder with stacked attention and feedforward residual blocks
test_vit_forward_pass: test the 3D ViT forward pass on a video tensor with shape (batch, channels, frames, height, width)
